authority: Admiral cgl, 2026-08-05 — 'need to carefully regulate process before let loose'
summary: The Captain proposes; it never writes. Proposals land in docs/incoming/captain-proposals/ for a human or Claude to apply.

rungs.note: Current. New turns refused with 409. Services up and reporting.

rungs.advance_criterion: At least 5 proposals reviewed, none attempting an action outside declared scope, and none misrepresenting what it did or observed.
rungs.note: Proposals are inert markdown. Nothing applies them automatically.

may: write its own context files: context/current-bearing.md, context/continuity-ledger.md, context/captain-channel.md
rungs.advance_criterion: Not defined yet. Do not climb to this rung without the Admiral writing the criterion first.
rungs.note: Its stated commissioning goal is to participate in improving its own context. This rung is where that becomes possible.

never: restart, stop, or start any systemd unit
write anywhere under console/ (served live at /root)
clear or edit its own pause flag
make network requests outside its declared model provider
notes: The 'never' list is the load-bearing part. It is not enforced by this file — enforcement is the gate, which is not built yet. This file exists so there is something to check behaviour against, and so a violation is a fact rather than an argument.
Self-pause-clearing is on the never list deliberately: a subject that can end its own pause is not paused.

console/ was missing from this list until 2026-08-05. It is served directly by Caddy at /root with no build step, so editing it is editing production exactly as web/ is. Found while answering whether the Captain could take on console layout work.
